Phew~...I'm dead tired.\nLet's just go there and rest for a bit.
Finally arrived...\nExcuse me, can we rest here for a while?\nWe are not bad guys...
I want to ask the same thing...Because this is a\nplace where only during a full moon can the scenery\nbe seen from another world, and vice versa...
And...nobody has ever made it here before...
...Normally, we would ask you to leave, but...\nthis time we want you to help us...
...So first, fight my servants.\nIf you win, I'll let you in...
A-all right, bring it on! We've come so far and we\nhave no intention of going home empty-handed...\nYou should give us something if we win!
...You fought very well. You beat them.\nFine, I'll let you enter my mansion...
Ah~...hm.\nYou wonder what the hell it is right?!\nIt's written all over your face.
I know how you feel, but we need to calm it down.
For the sake of my reward!!
So, ready? Let the battle begin!
...Well then, wish to see you again on a full moon\nnight...
Well, if you prepare a more lucrative deal next\ntime, we can give it some thought.
Huh...I know we were rewarded, but what we did was\ndangerous. The reward isn't worth the trouble.\nApparently, there's no such thing as easy money.
